scope: Synthesis of existing audited evidence only; no new data retrieval or trading simulation.

evidence_matrix.requirement: Exact fixed-contract identity for every leg/time
evidence_matrix.evidence: Phase 75: rolling Dhan response lacks per-bar exact expiry date; expiryCode/expiryFlag cannot establish contract expiry identity.
evidence_matrix.effect: Affected legs cannot be replayed as exact contracts.

evidence_matrix.evidence: Phase 76 pinned HF dataset files for 2026-07-28 and 2026-08-04 contain trades only through 2026-07-02; expiry sessions absent.
evidence_matrix.effect: Those expiry dates remain excluded; no imputation.

evidence_matrix.requirement: Automated-use and retention rights verified for complete sample
evidence_matrix.evidence: Prior source gates did not accept a source satisfying all sample, rights and target-coverage requirements. HF dataset card indicates CC-BY-NC-4.0, which is not accepted here as a general commercial-use clearance.
evidence_matrix.effect: No bulk raw-data caching/publication without documented terms.

evidence_matrix.evidence: Phase 51-3/50B frozen engine outputs include Paytm Money cost scenarios and friction stresses; Phase 77 ledger reconciliation passed. OHLC-based outcomes are not quote/depth-executable fills.
evidence_matrix.effect: Model accounting is reproducible but fill realism remains limited.

evidence_matrix.evidence: Phase 78: TT-04 historical HOLD base -₹6,456.29 and +50% friction -₹11,148.57; TT-05 HOLD base -₹40,244.68 and ₹20/order +50% friction -₹49,605.30, despite positive short partial-window outcomes.
Phase 71–78 branches record plans/status/error logs and completed workflow evidence; Phase 77 ledger reconciliation had no count/net errors.
evidence_matrix.effect: Sufficient to document the research no-go, not to claim profitability.

strategies.TT-02: Not supported in the available partial sample; negative in all four registered cost/friction cases.
strategies.TT-04: Not promoted; partial-window gains conflict with negative historical HOLD; bootstrap intervals include zero.
strategies.TT-05: Not promoted; partial-window gains conflict with negative historical HOLD; bootstrap intervals include zero.

reopen_only_if: A concrete source provides exact expiry/strike/side identity and complete target-date bars.
Documented license/API terms permit intended automated analysis and retention.
Quote/spread or defensible conservative execution assumptions and Paytm Money charges can be applied.
A pre-registered temporal test can be run without reusing the same holdout for tuning.
not_claimed: This is not proof that all strategies are unprofitable.
No strategy is approved for live trading.
The result does not replace the final research manuscript; it defines the evidence boundary and stop decision.
